name: Vimes's Report
summary: Captain Garran Vimes praises your work as the finest he has seen from an amateur. Now you carry his report to Theramore for Lady Jaina Proudmoore.

sections.title: A Report for Lady Proudmoore
sections.body: Lady Jaina Proudmoore asked Captain Vimes to keep her informed about a delicate situation. He has not spoken with her for some time. He planned to deliver the report later, but now sends you in his place. You may have better answers to her questions than he does.

faq.q: Who gives you the report to take to Jaina Proudmoore?
faq.answer: Captain Garran Vimes gives you his report for Lady Jaina Proudmoore in Theramore.

faq.q: Why does Captain Vimes send you instead of going himself?
faq.answer: Vimes has not spoken with Lady Proudmoore for some time, so he sends you in his place. He thinks you may have better answers to her questions.

faq.q: Where does the report need to go?
aliases: where to turn in vimes report
faq.answer: Take the report to Lady Jaina Proudmoore in Theramore.
